text: What happens to a pill after you swallow it?
In stomach acid, most tablets start to break apart and dissolve.
This is where most drugs actually get absorbed.
They pass through the gut wall and into your blood.
But that blood goes to your liver first.
Your gut wall and liver can break down part of the drug before the rest of your body sees it.
What's left rides your bloodstream all over your body.
Then your kidneys filter about a hundred and fifty quarts of blood every day.
Each kidney has about a million tiny filters.
Most drugs and their leftovers leave in your urine, down the ureters.
